## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the use case.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features? Describe them here.

```python
agent = AgentOS()
result = agent.new_feature(...)
```

## Benefits

- [ ] Enterprise users
- [ ] Plugin developers

If you have ideas about how this could be implemented, share them here.

## Related Features

- Related to #issue_number
- Works with existing feature X
- Extends capability Y

## Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Critical - Blocking my work
- [ ] High - Significantly improves my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or references here.
